User.title: User Profile
User.description: User account information, status, and latest location.

photoURL.description: The avatar URL of the user

activeCircleId.description: The currently selected active circle ID

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update

activeSOS.description: Whether the user has currently actived an SOS state

Circle.title: Family Circle
Circle.description: A group containing family members who share location and emergency alerts.

code.description: The unique invitation code to join this circle

createdById.description: The user who created the circle

CircleMember.title: Circle Member
CircleMember.description: The association of a user to a family circle.

joinedAt.description: Timestamp of when the user joined

SOSAlert.title: SOS Alert
SOSAlert.description: An active or resolved emergency SOS message sent by a circle member.

userId.description: The ID of the user in trouble

userName.description: The display name of the user in trouble

latitude.description: The latitude at time of alert

longitude.description: The longitude at time of alert

active.description: Whether the SOS is actively ongoing

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when this alert was created

resolvedAt.description: The timestamp of when this alert was resolved

resolvedBy.description: The user who resolved this alert

ChatMessage.title: Chat Message
ChatMessage.description: A coordination message sent within the circle.

senderName.description: The display name of the sender

SafeZone.title: Safe Zone
SafeZone.description: Geofenced safe boundaries (e.g., Home, Work, School).

latitude.description: The center latitude of the safe zone

longitude.description: The center longitude of the safe zone

users/{userId}.description: User profiles store settings, current location status, and active SOS flags.

circles/{circleId}.description: Circles representing families or core groups.

circles/{circleId}/members/{memberId}.description: Associates family members within each designated family circle.

circles/{circleId}/sos/{sosId}.description: List of emergency distress alerts associated with a circle.

circles/{circleId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Group chat and panic-sync text interface for circles.

circles/{circleId}/safezones/{zoneId}.description: Saves boundaries of interests such as Home, School, or Office.
